title: We have given you abundance beyond counting.
subtitle: Al-Kawthar: the river and all the good
then: Mockers said the Prophet ﷺ was cut off after his sons died. Then this surah came. He ﷺ said Al-Kawthar is {reward}a river my Lord promised me, with abundant good, a pond my Ummah will come to{/reward}. Ibn Abbas said it is {idea}the abundant goodness Allah gave him{/idea}, the river being part of it.
now: People write you off. A relative says you will never amount to much. A loss leaves you feeling your life has shrunk. {reward}Allah measures what you have been given very differently.{/reward} And this river is where the Ummah will drink, you included, if Allah wills.
old: Judging by what I have lost, I have been given very little.
new: Allah's gifts are counted in abundance, not in what others see me lose.
try: Send salawat on the Prophet ﷺ ten times today, and ask Allah to let you drink from Al-Kawthar.

title: So pray to your Lord, and sacrifice for Him.
subtitle: The answer to abundance is devotion

row.title: abundance given
sub: in this life and the next

then: Ibn Kathir says: just as We gave you abundant good, {idea}make your prayer and your sacrifice solely and sincerely for your Lord{/idea}. He links it to: {reward}my prayer, my sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah{/reward}.
now: Someone insults you in the comments. Your first urge is to reply, screenshot, defend. {idea}The surah gives a different reply: go and pray.{/idea} Turn the hurt into devotion, and let Allah handle the rest.
old: When I am insulted, I have to answer back.
new: My answer to mockery is turning to Allah in prayer and giving for His sake.
try: The next time someone hurts you with words, pray two rakahs before replying, if you reply at all.

title: The one who hates you is the one cut off.
subtitle: The insult turned around
then: Reports name Al-As bin Wa'il and others who said: {trap}leave him, he has no sons, he will not be remembered{/trap}. Ibn Kathir says, to the contrary, {reward}Allah preserved his remembrance for the whole world{/reward} until the Day of Gathering.
now: Billions of people today speak the name of the Prophet ﷺ in every prayer. The man who mocked him is known only because of this verse. {idea}Legacy is not what you leave in a will{/idea}. It is what Allah chooses to keep.
old: My legacy depends on my children, my money, or my reputation.
new: Allah decides who is remembered. Hating the truth is what truly cuts a person off.
try: Do one thing today whose good could outlast you: teach a verse, plant something, give to a lasting cause.
